description: This file defines classes and methods for managing company information and configuration wizards in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including default messages and user interface actions.

classes.name: res_company
classes.description: Extends the res.company model to add an overdue payment message field with a default message.

classes.name: company_setup
classes.description: A wizard class for setting up company information and overdue message customization.

methods.name: get_message
methods.description: Retrieves the overdue message and phone number for a company to display in the wizard.

methods.name: onchange_company_id
methods.description: Updates partner and overdue message fields when the company selection changes.

methods.name: action_create
methods.description: Saves the wizard data to the res.company model and opens a configuration window.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard and closes the window.
